email.verify.subject: Verify your email · Nothing Left
email.verify.body:
Hi {name},

Confirm this address to finish setting up your Nothing Left account:

{url}

The link works for 24 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this email.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your password · Nothing Left
email.password_reset.body:
Hi {name},

Use this single-use link to choose a new password:

{url}

It works for one hour and signs you out everywhere once used. If you did not ask for it, nothing has changed and you can ignore this email.
email.password_changed.subject: Your password was changed · Nothing Left
email.password_changed.body:
Hi {name},

The password on your Nothing Left account was just changed.

If that was not you, reset your password immediately and revoke your active sessions:

{url}
email.unverified_account_linked.subject: Your password was removed · Nothing Left
email.unverified_account_linked.body:
Hi {name},

You just signed in with {provider} as {email}. An account for this address already existed, but the address had never been confirmed.

Because nobody had proven they own this address, we removed that account's password and signed out its other sessions. Nothing in the account was deleted, and {provider} now signs you in.

To sign in with a password as well, set a new one:

{url}

If you never created that earlier account, someone else registered your address. They no longer have access.
email.email_change_verify.subject: Confirm your new email · Nothing Left
email.email_change_verify.body:
Hi {name},

Confirm {new_email} as the address for your Nothing Left account:

{url}

The link works for 24 hours. Your current address stays in place until you confirm.
email.email_changed.subject: Your email address was changed · Nothing Left
email.email_changed.body:
Hi {name},

The address on your Nothing Left account changed from {old_email} to {new_email}.

If that was not you, reply to this email immediately.
email.pat_created.subject: A new access token was created · Nothing Left
email.pat_created.body:
Hi {name},

An access token named "{token_name}" was just created on your Nothing Left account.

If that was not you, revoke it and change your password:

{url}
email.two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on · Nothing Left
email.two_factor_enabled.body:
Hi {name},

Two-factor authentication is now on for your Nothing Left account. Signing in with your password will also ask for a code from your authenticator app.

Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. If this was not you, change your password and review your account:

{url}
email.two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off · Nothing Left
email.two_factor_disabled.body:
Hi {name},

Two-factor authentication was turned off on your Nothing Left account. Signing in now needs only your password.

If this was not you, change your password immediately and turn it back on:

{url}
email.recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used · Nothing Left
email.recovery_code_used.body:
Hi {name},

A recovery code was just used on your Nothing Left account. You have {remaining} left.

If you lost your phone, set up your authenticator again and create new recovery codes. If this was not you, change your password immediately:

{url}
email.recovery_codes_regenerated.subject: New recovery codes were created · Nothing Left
email.recovery_codes_regenerated.body:
Hi {name},

New recovery codes were created for your Nothing Left account. The old ones no longer work.

If this was not you, change your password immediately:

{url}
email.account_deactivated.subject: Your account was deactivated · Nothing Left
email.account_deactivated.body:
Hi {name},

Your Nothing Left account is deactivated. You are signed out everywhere and your access tokens no longer work. Your name stays on everything you wrote.

To reactivate it, reply to this email from this address.
email.account_reactivated.subject: Your account is active again · Nothing Left
email.account_reactivated.body:
Hi {name},

Your Nothing Left account is active again, with every organisation and project it had. Sign in to continue; create new access tokens if you need them.
email.org_deletion_scheduled.subject: {org} is scheduled for deletion · Nothing Left
email.org_deletion_scheduled.body:
Hi {name},

{actor} asked to delete {org}. Unless the owner cancels, {org} and everything in it will be deleted on {date}.

Until then everyone can keep working. The owner can cancel here:

{url}
email.org_deletion_reminder.subject: {org} will be deleted tomorrow · Nothing Left
email.org_deletion_reminder.body:
Hi {name},

{org} and everything in it will be deleted on {date}. Export anything you need before then.

The owner can still cancel here:

{url}
email.org_deletion_cancelled.subject: {org} will not be deleted · Nothing Left
email.org_deleted.subject: {org} was deleted · Nothing Left
email.org_deleted.body:
Hi {name},

{org} has been deleted, with its projects, issues and files. Your account and your other organisations are untouched.
email.ownership_offered.subject: {owner} wants to make you the owner of {org} · Nothing Left
email.ownership_offered.body:
Hi {name},

{owner} wants to hand ownership of {org} to you. The owner can delete the organisation and transfer it again.

Accept or decline here:

{url}

The link works for 7 days.
email.ownership_offer_sent.subject: You offered {org} to {target} · Nothing Left
email.ownership_offer_cancelled.subject: The ownership transfer of {org} was cancelled · Nothing Left
email.ownership_offer_cancelled.body:
Hi {name},

{owner} cancelled the offer to make you the owner of {org}. Nothing changed.
email.ownership_offer_declined.subject: {target} declined to own {org} · Nothing Left
email.ownership_received.subject: You now own {org} · Nothing Left
email.ownership_handed_over.subject: {other} now owns {org} · Nothing Left
email.invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {org} · Nothing Left
email.invitation.body:
Hi,

{inviter} invited you to join {org} on Nothing Left as {role}.

Accept the invitation here:

{url}

The link works for 14 days and only for {email}. If you were not expecting it, ignore this email.
email.invitation_project.body:
Hi,

{inviter} invited you to the project {project} in {org} on Nothing Left, as {role}.

Accept the invitation here:

{url}

The link works for 14 days and only for {email}. If you were not expecting it, ignore this email.
email.member_removed.subject: You were removed from {org} · Nothing Left
email.member_removed.body:
Hi {name},

{actor} removed you from {org} on Nothing Left. You no longer have access to its projects.

Your account is untouched, and so is every other organisation you belong to. Anything you wrote in {org} stays there under your name.
email.role_raised.subject: You are now an admin of {org} · Nothing Left
email.role_raised.body:
Hi {name},

{actor} made you an Org Admin of {org} on Nothing Left. You can now manage members, invitations, projects and organisation settings.

{url}

If this looks wrong, tell {actor}.
email.project_role_raised.subject: You are now a Project Admin on {project} · Nothing Left
email.project_role_raised.body:
Hi {name},

{actor} made you a Project Admin on {project} in {org}. You can now manage the project's settings, people and invitations.

{url}

If this looks wrong, tell {actor}.
email.storage_almost_full.subject: Your storage is almost full · Nothing Left
email.storage_almost_full.body:
Hi {name},

{org} has used {used} of its {limit} of file storage ({percent}%). When it is full, nobody in {org} can upload files.

To make room, delete files you no longer need, or connect your own Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3 bucket for unlimited storage:

{url}
email.storage_full.subject: Your storage is full · Nothing Left
email.storage_full.body:
Hi {name},

{org} is out of file storage ({used} of {limit} used), so uploads are now refused.

There are two ways to upload again: delete files you no longer need, or connect your own Cloudflare R2 or AWS S3 bucket for unlimited storage:

{url}
email.storage_connected.subject: {org} now stores files in your own bucket · Nothing Left
email.storage_connected.body:
Hi {name},

{actor} connected the storage bucket {bucket} to {org}. Files uploaded in {org} are stored there from now on, and they no longer count against its storage limit.

If you did not expect this, review the storage settings now:

{url}
email.storage_disconnected.subject: Your storage bucket was disconnected from {org} · Nothing Left
email.storage_byo_failed.subject: Fix the storage connection for {org} · Nothing Left
email.storage_byo_failed.body:
Hi {name},

The storage bucket {bucket} refused a request from {org}: its access key was rejected, or lost a permission it needs. Until the key is fixed, files in that bucket cannot be opened and nobody in {org} can upload.

Update the access key in the storage settings:

{url}
email.export_ready.subject: Your export of {org} is ready · Nothing Left
email.export_ready.body:
Hi {name},

The export of {org} you asked for is ready: one {size} archive with every project, issue, article and file. It can be downloaded until {date}.

Download it from the organisation settings:

{url}

email.git_connection_attention.subject: Fix the git connection {connection} · Nothing Left
email.git_connection_attention.body:
Hi {name},

The git connection {connection} in {org} needs attention: {reason}.

Until it is fixed, new branches, commits and pull requests from it do not reach your issues. What is already linked stays.

Review it in organisation settings:

{url}
email.git_identity_verify.subject: Confirm {email} for your commits · Nothing Left
email.git_identity_verify.body:
Hi {name},

You asked for commits written as {email} to be shown as yours in Nothing Left. Confirm that the address is yours:

{url}

The link works for 24 hours. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: nothing changes until the link is followed.
email.git_token_expiring.subject: The token for {connection} expires {date} · Nothing Left
email.git_token_expiring.body:
Hi {name},

The access token of the git connection {connection} in {org} expires on {date}. After that, new branches, commits and pull requests from it stop reaching your issues.

Create a new token at the provider and connect it again from organisation settings:

{url}
